<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 5"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Chemical Trail](/Feats.aspx?ID=5389) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Exploration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=595" />
<trait label="Surki" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=789" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 50

</column>

---

You can leave a faint chemical trail as you move and can use the chemical trails of other surkis to navigate. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to all checks and saves to [Sense Direction](/Actions.aspx?ID=2406) or reorient yourself.
name: Chemical Trail
